feedback: Delivery was 55 minutes late and food arrived cold. Driver was apparently parked 2km away for 20 minutes.
The new 'Group Order' feature is perfect for ordering with colleagues. Smooth experience.
Restaurant cancelled my order 35 minutes after I placed it. Dinner ruined, kids were crying.
Ordered a veg meal — received a non-veg dish. This is completely unacceptable.
The live order tracking map is so satisfying. Love watching the driver navigate to me.
Promo code gave me a discount but then order total increased at checkout for no reason.
Delivery partner was rude and threw the bag at my door. Food spilled everywhere.
App crashes at the payment screen every single time. Have to place orders on the website.
Restaurant listings show places that have been permanently closed for months.
The scheduled delivery feature is a lifesaver — set it for 8pm and it arrived exactly on time.
Refund for a missing item is taking 9 business days. That's way too long.
Search completely ignores my location and shows restaurants that don't deliver to me.
Got charged for an order that was never confirmed. The payment went through but no order was placed.
The 'reorder' button is the best feature ever added. Re-ordered my usual lunch in 2 taps.
Multiple items marked as unavailable AFTER I placed the order. Should show this before.
Portion sizes from restaurants look nothing like the photos. Misleading and disappointing.
Customer support is chatbot-only now and it's completely useless for complex issues.
The nutrition information for menu items is a great addition. Really helps me make better choices.
My address saved incorrectly and delivered to the wrong building. Support blamed me.
The subscription plan is worth every rupee. Free delivery every day adds up to huge savings.
Delivery partner marked order as delivered 20 minutes before arrival. GPS was showing wrong location.
Payment wallet balance disappeared after app update. Over ₹500 just vanished.
Why do restaurants show as 'Open' when they're clearly not taking orders? Wastes so much time.
The restaurant ratings are fake — 4.5 star place had cold, stale food 3 times in a row.
Quick commerce delivery in 15 minutes is genuinely impressive. Actually arrived in 12!
Order tracking got stuck on 'Preparing' for 90 minutes. Food arrived with no status update.
The allergen filter is an amazing safety feature. As someone with a nut allergy, this is essential.
App shows estimated delivery as 25 minutes but actual delivery was 75 minutes with no update.
My loyalty points expired without any warning notification. Lost 2,400 points.
Dark mode is perfect — makes late-night ordering so much more comfortable.
I can't delete old saved addresses. The delete button does nothing.
Recommended restaurants on my homepage are completely irrelevant to my taste preferences.
The food photography in this app is stunning. Actually makes me want to try new restaurants.
Got a delivery bag with someone else's order inside. Had to wait another hour for correct order.
Minimum order amount increased without any announcement. Was not happy to discover this at checkout.
The in-app chat with the delivery partner is a great idea but the chat window keeps closing.
Corporate meal allowance integration with my company's expense system works flawlessly.
Restaurant accepted my order and then immediately cancelled saying 'high demand'. Scam-like behavior.
Birthday cashback offer wasn't applied even though I met all conditions. Support was unhelpful.
Contactless delivery instructions were completely ignored. Driver rang the bell and woke my baby.
Love that I can rate individual items, not just the restaurant. More useful feedback for everyone.
App used my location to switch to a different city's restaurants. Ordered from a restaurant 30km away.
Introducing pre-order for restaurants that open later was brilliant. No more missing out on popular places.
UPI payment fails 4 out of 5 times. Have to use card instead.
The 'Leave at door' option doesn't show up for my address even though it's a residential building.
Surprise discovery feature introduced me to a hidden gem restaurant 500m from my house. Amazing!
Live support agents are knowledgeable and resolved my complaint with a full refund in 5 minutes.
App doesn't remember my payment preference. Have to select UPI every single time.
Restaurant marked my special instructions as 'noted' but completely ignored them.
Best food delivery experience I've had. Consistent, fast, and the app just works.
